summary: Session 16 — Produksi & Gudang module + vercel.json SPA rewrite regression pass. react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated — use style.boxShadow. Reference: multiple components using shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius. Non-blocking (already reported in iteration_15).
Console warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated — use style.pointerEvents. Non-blocking.
Console warning: useNativeDriver not supported on web preview; falls back to JS animation. Gate with Platform.OS !== 'web'. Non-blocking.

rca_of_issue: N/A — no regressions. The vercel.json change from complex negative-lookahead to simple '/(.*)' catch-all is the standard Expo Router SPA pattern (client-side routing needs every unknown path to serve index.html). Local Expo web preview served through Metro is unaffected because it uses its own dev server, not vercel.json; Vercel deployment will need to be verified post-deploy on airoxly.vercel.app.
